records.text: Owens reports that Polymarket odds of Democrats sweeping both chambers in the 2026 midterms surged to a record high.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So Polymarket basically dropped odds and said that Democrats are surging to record high. The odds of them sweeping both chambers of Congress in 2026 midterms have soared and this caused a remarkable crash out across the people.
